qs: what data tools does jerry use
a: Jerry's stack: Python, Rust, Go, C/C++, CUDA, TypeScript; Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD, AWS, GCP; Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, PyTorch.
kvm is a GPU virtual machine: one kernel runs real Doom, trains a 162M GPT and serves live inference. It is v2 of open-flapping-airplanes.
open-flapping-airplanes is one persistent GPU kernel that trains a language model, serves it live, and plays Doom at the same time.
cakebench is a kernel benchmark modelled on the CAKE paper. It scores hand-written or LLM-generated kernels such as kmeans_assign and knn_search.
qwenagent puts small stateful worker modules inside a frozen Qwen3-0.6B: private recurrent states, a learned slot router and a return channel.
amd-experiments benchmarks TurboQuant, IsoQuant, PlanarQuant and RotorQuant KV cache compression on an AMD MI300X with Triton/ROCm kernels.
nvim-in-nvim is a Vim-like editor in about 1,900 lines of Lua running on top of Neovim, with its own init.lua config system.
daw-in-daw is a complete multitrack DAW written in pure Lua that runs inside REAPER.
qwentensor lets you write a PyTorch network, quantize it to 5-bit integers and run it inside Qwen3.5. No GPU kernels, no training.
qwen-os is a tiny OS that boots, opens a shell and runs real DOOM on a RISC-V CPU compiled into the weights of Qwen3.5-4B.
qwengl is a GL-style graphics library computed inside a stock Qwen3.5-0.8B. There are no shaders, and the model's tokens are the pixels.
recursive-dflash2 trains a drafter for recursive speculative decoding, using Qwen3-4B as the target model.
north-star is a fast Triton decode executor with prompt-lookup speculation for the Cohere North MoE, reaching 3.2-4.4x tok/s on an H100.

qs: what is the ten percent challenge
a: ten-percent-challenge: keep at most 10 percent of a model's fp16 size and match its behaviour on an unseen exam, without training the weights.
allgit is next-gen version control in Rust: one global object graph, independent zones and S3-backed remotes.
qwentpu is a TPU compiled into the weights of a stock Qwen3.5 (0.8B, 2B or 4B), with no TPU hardware and no training.
qweninqwen computes a real Qwen3-0.6B token using the weights and recurrent state of another, stock Qwen.
bobliu-os is a from-scratch 32-bit x86 OS: preemptive multitasking, COW fork, VFS, libc, shell, Lua and DOOM.
